---
title: "Visualize direct cell neighbors"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

Build a polygon proximity graph for a Xenium crop and inspect alternative ways to draw direct neighbor edges on cell segmentation plots.

Source script: [R/Visualizing_DirectNeighbors.R](../R/Visualizing_DirectNeighbors.R). The code below retains the source script's order and comments.

## Setup

Enable evaluation and code display for all chunks, and resolve the source script's relative paths from the project root when knitting this file from the Vignettes folder.

```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
)
```

## Load packages

Load the spatial graph, geometry, plotting, and animation libraries.

install.packages("gifski")

```{r step-01, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
library("RGraphSpace")
library("sf")
library("ggplot2")
library("igraph")
library("dplyr")
library("gifski")
library("gridExtra")
```

## Load the Xenium crop

Download the cropped GraphSpace object if needed and read it into the session.

```{r step-02, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# download crop
diretorio_dados <- "data"
url_dados <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flaviogckessler/Curso_ST/",
  "main/data/Xenium_GS_Crop.RDS")

arquivo_dados <- file.path(diretorio_dados, "Xenium_GS_Crop.RDS")

if (!file.exists(arquivo_dados)) {
  utils::download.file(url_dados,arquivo_dados,mode = "wb")}

gs_crop <- readRDS(arquivo_dados)

if (!inherits(gs_crop, "GraphSpace")) {
  stop("O arquivo baixado não contém um objeto da classe GraphSpace.")}

gs_crop
#########
```

## Configure plotting

Define a shared palette, expression range, and coordinate theme.

```{r step-03, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Set color palette and data range for use across plots
cpal <- hcl.colors(100, palette = "Spectral", rev = T)
data_range <- c(0, 7)
# Set a reusable theme
my_theme <- theme_gspace_coords(theme = "th3", is_norm = TRUE, 
                                xlab = "Tissue coordinates 1", ylab = "Tissue coordinates 2")
#########
```

## Load the neighbor helper

Source the function that finds neighbors using segmentation polygons.

```{r step-04, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# load function that calculate that find the spot/cells neighbors based on the cell segmentation info
source("R/gs_neighbors_func.R")
#########
```

## Inspect the segmentation plot

Display the crop with polygons colored by Slc17a7 expression.

```{r step-05, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
p1 <- ggplot(gs_crop) +
  geom_sf(
    mapping = aes(
      geometry = geometry,
      fill = log2(Slc17a7 + 1))) +
  scale_fill_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range) +
  geom_nodespace(colour = "black", size = 0.2, pch = 19) +
  my_theme

p1
```

## Build and plot the neighbor graph

Construct a graph using the selected polygon distance and plot its edges with and without the segmentation layer.

```{r step-06, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
gs_neig <- gs_neighbors(gs_crop,dist=0.0005)

p1 <- ggplot(gs_neig) +
  geom_edgespace(color="red")+
  geom_nodespace(color="black",
                 size = .2,pch = 19) +
  scale_colour_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range)+
  theme_gspace_coords(theme = "th3",is_norm = TRUE)+
  my_theme

p2 <- ggplot(gs_neig) +
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(geometry = geometry,fill = log2(Slc17a7 + 1))) +
  scale_fill_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range) +
  #geom_nodespace(colour = "black", size = 0.2, pch = 19) +
  geom_edgespace(color="red",alpha=0.3)+
  my_theme

grid.arrange(p1,p2,ncol=2)
```

## Inspect a smaller region

Crop and normalize the graph, then save a close-up of the neighbor edges.

```{r step-07, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Crop to the smaller region and re-normalize coordinates
gs_neig2 <- cropGraphSpace(gs_neig, 
                           xmin = 0.45, xmax = 0.6, 
                           ymin = 0.2, ymax = 0.35)
gs_neig2 <- normalizeGraphSpace(gs_neig2, mar = 0, norm.geometry = TRUE)

g <- ggplot(gs_neig2) +
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(geometry = geometry,fill = log2(Slc17a7 + 1))) +
  scale_fill_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range) +
  #geom_nodespace(colour = "black", size = 0.2, pch = 19) +
  geom_edgespace(color="red",alpha=0.8)+
  my_theme
g
ggsave("images/DirectNeighbors_Edges1.png",g,
       height = 4,width = 7,units = "in",dpi = 120)

```

## Change edge rendering

Set the edge arrow type and save the resulting segmentation view.

```{r step-08, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
gs_edge_attr(gs_neig2,"arrowType") <- "13|-|13"

g<- ggplot(gs_neig2) +
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(geometry = geometry,fill = log2(Slc17a7 + 1))) +
  scale_fill_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range) +
  geom_edgespace(color="black",alpha=0.8)+
  my_theme
g

ggsave("images/DirectNeighbors_Edges2.png",g,
       height = 4,width = 7,units = "in",dpi = 120)

```

## Adjust node rendering

Add the transparent node layer used in the source script and save the final view.

```{r step-09, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
g<-ggplot(gs_neig2) +
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(geometry = geometry,fill = log2(Slc17a7 + 1))) +
  scale_fill_continuous(palette = cpal, limits = data_range) +
  geom_nodespace(colour = "black", size = 15, pch = 19,alpha=0) +
  geom_edgespace(color="black",alpha=0.8)+
  my_theme
g

ggsave("images/DirectNeighbors_Edges3.png",g,
       height = 4,width = 7,units = "in",dpi = 120)
```
